method.rule: ADANIENT 9:15-9:45 range breakout; first 1-minute close outside it by 13:00 buys the ATM call (up) or put (down) at the next minute; otherwise exit at 15:15. 1 lot, nearest weekly expiry. Stop-loss: the bought option's own 9:15-9:45 low (live from 26 Nov 2026; earlier real NIFTY days used NIFTY crossing back through the range).
method.prices: Times and levels: real Adani Enterprises 1-minute share prices (adjusted back to the traded price around any bonus or split). Option prices: a model set each day from the stock's own real option prices (NSE bhavcopy), nearest monthly expiry and listed strike; 1 lot = 309 shares today (fewer shares before a bonus or split, same exposure). 'Real' days are the app's own paper trades.
method.bias: The model flatters option buyers by about Rs 160-330 a trade (checked on real prices).
